description: A traditional residential exterior photographed at twilight from standing eye-level with a normal-to-wide lens, framing a centered symmetrical view of a classic French country-style home facade. The house is clad in warm cream stucco with decorative arched window surrounds, a steep grey slate hip roof, and an ornate circular porthole window centered above the main facade. The windows glow with warm amber interior light, revealing soft domestic interiors beyond sheer curtains. A manicured green lawn occupies the foreground, bordered by a curved flower bed of pink roses and leafy ornamental planting along the foundation. A gravel and wood walkway leads from the foreground toward the entrance, and dense round hedge shrubs frame the right side of the facade. The deep blue dusk sky transitions from cool cobalt at the top of the frame to a warm amber glow at the horizon line. Two tall black iron post-mounted glowing lanterns stand in the lawn — one large and dominant in the left foreground, one smaller to the right near the house facade — both emitting warm amber pools of light that spread across the grass and gravel at their bases. The overall mood is formal, classically composed, and warmly welcoming.
